items.title: A field extension is a filtered colimit of global complete intersections, and of smooth algebras when separable
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a field extension is a filtered colimit of global complete intersection algebras over the base, and of smooth algebras when the extension is separable (statement lines 44743-44749). The proof does not construct a presentation of the whole extension: it reduces to a single finite subset, disposes of the separable case by the corresponding smoothness statement, and in general exhibits a subalgebra generated by a transcendence basis plus one algebraic element subject to a polynomial relation, which is visibly a global complete intersection (proof lines 44751-44776). Reducing the whole extension to one finite subset at a time is what makes the construction finite. H2.
